tools.name: anny_card
tools.description: Assemble a character — composite body/hair/outfit GLBs, render the 8-view turnaround, segment a source photo into part sprites.

body_glb.description: The base body — empty autoloads the Model-declared neutral body (anny-base-body.glb, provisioned); or attach a rigged/static character GLB. (Photo→body estimation is the pilot arc; clothing composite moves to its own card later.)

source_image.description: Character photo — SAM segments hair/outfit sprites (feeds the estimator arc).

resolution.description: Pixel size of each turnaround view.

framing.description: Camera distance factor — larger frames the whole body looser.

focal_length.description: Lens focal length — lower = wider perspective.

samples.description: Render samples per view — more = cleaner but slower.

transparent.description: Transparent turnaround background (for compositing into sheets).

tools.name: auto_rig_card
tools.description: Static mesh GLB → generated skeleton + learned skin weights → rigged GLB (TokenRig on GGML)

input.description: Static .glb/.t2mesh path or artifact-ref from a previous card (anny bake, trellis lift)

device.description: cpu (lane default — never touches the GPU) / auto / vulkan (contends with ComfyUI)

postprocess.description: Opt-in surface-locality heuristic (upstream demo's own default is off — raw learned weights)

tools.name: fit_card
tools.description: Seat a static prop onto a SOMAX body under the placement laws.

tools.name: forge_card
tools.description: Breed a creature spec → validate → compile to GLB

tools.name: h3_timeline_card
tools.description: THE video interface — multi-window film with SLA sparse attention, joint video+audio per window, auto-stitched into one mp4. The calls document IS the timeline.

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: h3-timeline, h3, h3-keyframe.

prompt.description: Verb-first motion + the sounds. For keyframes the image already sets the scene — prompt what CHANGES.

image.description: Absolute path to the PNG the video must start on (h3-keyframe). Optional for h3/h3-timeline.

seed.description: Same seed across re-rolls = same world texture

steps.description: 12 for draft; 30 standard; 10 with the turbo LoRA

sharpen_enabled.description: Apply AMD FidelityFX RCAS sharpening to the final output. Strength 0.3 looks natural.

sharpen_strength.description: RCAS sharpening intensity. 0.3 = natural; 0.5 = crisp; 0.0 = off.

interpolate_enabled.description: Apply FILM (Feature-aware Interpolation for Large Motion) frame interpolation to double the frame rate. Doubles render time.

shift_video.description: Timestep shift for video attention. Higher = more coherent motion.

shift_audio.description: Timestep shift for audio attention. Lower = more detailed sound.

tools.name: ideogram4_card
tools.description: Typography-aware text-to-image with clean, legible text rendering.

cfg.description: How closely the diffusion follows the prompt. Higher = stricter.

mu.description: Ideogram4 scheduler mean shift — the official Default preset is 0.5.

std.description: Ideogram4 scheduler spread — the official Default preset is 1.75.

sampler.description: Sampler — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

tools.name: image_edit_card
tools.description: Instruction-driven image editing — the edit_image interface card boarding the Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 lane; the family carries the lightning / standard cascade (variant/quant always shown) plus the lanpaint flavor (required anchor image). The surface scopes itself.

reference_images.description: Multi-image picker (up to 3). Used by workflows that pass resolved image lists; complements the individual Image 2 / Image 3 slots above.

sampler.description: Sampler — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

scheduler.description: Scheduler — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

use_stock_nodes.description: When true, build_img2img_edit emits the stock Qwen-Image-Edit node graph (no DiffSynth patches, no custom ControlNet wiring). Useful for reproducing upstream behavior exactly.

double_reference.description: Encode the input image twice (VAE + vision encoder) for stronger identity preservation. Disable for faster runs where identity drift is acceptable.

mask.description: Add the mask mod, then drop an RGBA PNG whose alpha channel marks the region.

input_mask.description: RGBA PNG whose alpha channel marks the region. Standalone: region semantics for this lane. Alongside lanpaint: the inpaint region — present with image1, the builder switches to the lanpaint sampler.

mask_mode.description: How the mask is honored: auto (the lane's own region ControlNet if its weights are present, else crop+stitch), crop_stitch (crop to the mask + context, work the crop, composite back — pixels outside the mask never change), full_frame (legacy whole-image pass; unmasked regions may drift).

mask_context_pad.description: Pixels of surrounding context kept in the crop (crop_stitch mode). More context = more coherence; 64 is the sweet spot.

mask_grow.description: Expand (+) or shrink (−) the region by an exact pixel disk before the run. Applied host-side.

mask_feather.description: Gaussian falloff the composite blends through — kills the pasted-on rectangle edge.

mask_threshold.description: Re-binarize the feathered mask at this level. 0 = keep the soft falloff.

mask_invert.description: Work OUTSIDE the painted region instead.

tools.name: image_gen_card
tools.description: Text-to-image generation — the generate_image interface card boarding krea-2; the family declares its mods (loras) and the surface scopes itself

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: krea-2, z-image, anima.

cfg.description: How closely the diffusion follows the prompt. Higher = stricter.

sampler.description: Sampler — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

scheduler.description: Scheduler — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

tools.name: img_to_mesh_card
tools.description: The 3D lane — lift one image into a textured mesh (.glb) on native TRELLIS.2 (DINOv3 conditioning) or native Pixal3D (pixel-aligned + MoGe camera FOV, hero tier), or copy a rig onto a target GLB (transfer_rig); one surface, one arm per family.

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: trellis2-native, pixal3d, transfer_rig.

input_image.description: One clear object, tight framing. Background is removed automatically (birefnet) unless bg_removal=off.

rigged_glb.description: The SOMA-rigged clean mesh — JOINTS_0/WEIGHTS_0 + armature. The rig donor.

target_glb.description: The clothed mesh — geometry + textures, no rig. Receives the rig.

seed.description: Same seed + image = same mesh take.

resolution.description: Upsample target (official pins 1536). All tiers run the full official chain — upsample + both texture passes + remesh tail.

steps.description: STRUCTURE stage steps (the lift). Shape + texture stages ride their own knobs in the Stage section.

cfg.description: Structure-stage guidance. 7.5 is the official template calibration (2026-09-06: the 3.0 default sampled the coarse shape at under half guidance — blobby trash out of the box). Lower runs looser.

bg_removal.description: auto/on: birefnet cuts the background (recommended). off: feed a pre-cleaned or alpha-cut image straight to conditioning.

camera_fov.description: Pixal3D only — per-image horizontal FoV feeding the camera transform matrix. auto: MoGeInference estimates from the source image (recommended); a literal degree value skips MoGe (operator-vouched camera, e.g. calibrated).

shape_steps.description: Shape-stage steps. 20 is the official template calibration.

shape_cfg.description: Shape-stage guidance. 7.5 is the official template calibration.

tex1_steps.description: First texture pass steps (upsampled latent, simple scheduler). 12 is the official calibration.

tex1_cfg.description: First texture pass guidance. 7.5 is the official calibration.

tex2_steps.description: Second texture pass steps (raw unet — the detail pass). 12 is the official calibration.

tex2_cfg.description: Second texture pass guidance. 1.0 is the official calibration (near-verbatim detail sampling).

remesh_resolution.description: UDF remesh voxel resolution. 768 is the official calibration; lower = lighter mesh, coarser surface.

decimate_faces.description: Exact face count after decimation (midpoint placement). 700000 is the official calibration.

smooth_angle.description: Normal-smoothing crease angle, applied before unwrap and after texturing. 180 is the official calibration.

atlas_size.description: Unwrap + baked color atlas resolution. 4096 is the official calibration (VRAM-heavy); 2048 is the lighter fallback.

ao_size.description: Ambient-occlusion bake resolution. 1024 is the official calibration.

normal_size.description: Normal-map bake resolution. 2048 is the official calibration.

struct_sampler.description: Structure-stage sampler. euler is the official template pick. — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

struct_scheduler.description: Structure-stage scheduler. normal is the official pick. — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

shape_sampler.description: Shape-stage sampler. euler is the official pick. — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

shape_scheduler.description: Shape-stage scheduler. normal is the official pick. — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

tex1_sampler.description: First texture pass sampler. euler is the official pick. — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

tex1_scheduler.description: First texture pass scheduler. simple is the official pick (the only non-normal scheduler in the template). — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

tex2_sampler.description: Second texture pass sampler. euler is the official pick. — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

tex2_scheduler.description: Second texture pass scheduler. normal is the official pick. — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

sd3_shift.description: ModelSamplingSD3 shift on the structure arm. 5.0 is the official template calibration.

rescale_struct.description: Structure-arm RescaleCFG multiplier. 0.7 is the official calibration.

rescale_shape.description: Shape-arm RescaleCFG multiplier (also feeds texture pass 1 — one node). 0.5 is the official calibration.

override_struct.description: Structure-arm CFGOverride start percent. 0.667 is the official calibration.

override_shape.description: Shape-arm CFGOverride start percent. 0.769 is the official calibration.

tools.name: input_prep_card
tools.description: Source intake: attach an image or audio file (upload, asset drop, prior run) — staged, optionally transformed, emitted as a media artifact for downstream cards to wire.

source.description: The file to stage — upload, asset drop, prior-run artifact, or mount path. Image or audio (video is not boarded yet).

tools.name: mask_studio_card
tools.description: Selection-only mask card: detect people/subjects, refine with SAM3, paint corrections → mask artifacts for inpaint flows.

input_image.description: The photo to select from — absolute path or an artifact ref from a prior run.

detect_mode.description: What the primary selection targets. body → RT-DETR person boxes refined by SAM3; face/hands → SAM3 open-vocabulary text selection.

detection_threshold.description: RT-DETR box confidence. Lower catches more instances, noisier boxes.

sam_dilation.description: Grow the final mask N pixels — the inpaint bleed margin.

output_mode.description: segm saves masks; bbox saves the drawn-box manifest preview.

instance_filter.description: 'all' | 'largest' | comma indices '0,2' — which detected instances the primary keeps.

max_instances.description: Cap detected instances (0 = no cap). Read the manifest first, then filter.

sam3_prompt.description: Open-vocabulary text selection — e.g. 'the red hat', 'left shoe'. Rides INSTEAD of detect_mode when set.

export_boxes.description: Draw RT-DETR boxes on the image — the instance manifest (read it, then set instance_filter).

export_paint.description: ON when a brush stroke exists — the painted payload becomes its own mask export.

paint_mask.description: The painted PNG (alpha channel = strokes). Required when export_paint is true.

roi.description: [x, y, w, h] fractions — run-global crop of every selection. Recipe filters may carry their own; identical scopes only.

outputs.description: THE recipe form: one entry per mask, filter (where) over selection (how). Non-empty ⇒ overrides the flat params. See AGENT.md.

tools.name: motion_card
tools.description: Text → 3D human motion (SOMA-77 pose NPZ). Chain segments, constrain joints, skin onto a rigged character GLB.

prompt.description: What the body DOES — verb-first, one continuous action per segment. Multi-segment: separate with | and pair with motion_prompts.

seed.description: Same seed + prompt = same motion take.

duration_sec.description: Length of the generated motion segment.

diffusion_steps.description: More steps = smoother arcs; 25 is the calibrated default.

num_samples.description: Takes per prompt (each becomes its own NPZ).

num_transition_frames.description: Blend frames when chaining onto a previous motion (motion_npz).

cfg_type.description: separated = independent text/action guidance (calibrated); nocfg = fastest.

motion_npz.description: Previous motion NPZ to continue — the new prompt takes over after num_transition_frames of blend.

motion_prompts.description: Segment prompts joined with | — one motion per segment, auto-chained in order.

motion_constraints.description: Pin joints (e.g. left_foot:ground) — JSON or key:value lines, applied per segment.

preview_glb.description: SOMAX-rigged character GLB — the motion is skinned onto it (somax bake) as an animated GLB artifact.

tools.name: music_card
tools.description: Generate music — MiniMax Music 3, structured captions (Genre + Vocal Details + Arrangement) with tagged lyrics

prompt.description: Structured caption: Genre + Vocal Details + Arrangement. E.g. 'funk, pop, soul, guitar, 105 BPM'.

lyrics.description: Lyrics with structure tags: [verse], [chorus], [bridge]. Empty = instrumental.

n_diffusion_steps.description: Flow-matching denoising steps. 30 = lane default. Never 0.

tools.name: music_native_card
tools.description: audio.cpp music lane — ACE-Step 1.5 XL / SFT or MiniMax Music 3 text-to-music (the audio_cpp binding layer calls audiocpp_cli with the family + model name from each model row)

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: ace-step-xl, ace-step-sft, txt2music.

prompt.description: Genre, era, region, 2-3 style anchors, tempo in BPM, key if known

lyrics.description: Section tags [verse] [pre-chorus] [chorus] [bridge] [outro]; txt2music honours them, ACE-Step ignores

duration.description: Target length in seconds (audio.cpp caps at 10 minutes)

backend.description: cuda = GPU; cpu = GGUF CPU path (CUDA absent)

family.description: audio_cpp family — the renderer reads lane_inputs.family from the picked model row

tools.name: quad_remesh_card
tools.description: High-poly mesh → clean quad topology

input.description: OBJ/STL/PLY path or artifact-ref from a previous card

tools.name: sfx_card
tools.description: Generate sound effects — MOSS-SFX v2, describe the SOUND not the scene

prompt.description: Describe the SOUND itself, not the scene (e.g. 'sharp metallic clang with long decay')

tools.name: skin_card
tools.description: Deterministic skin detail maps onto a SOMAX body (kind sidecar + proof turnaround).

tools.name: tagger_card
tools.description: Image prompt inversion — booru keyword tags (WD14, JoyTag) and natural-language captions (Florence-2, JoyCaption) for recreating images in NovelAI / Pony / FLUX / Ideogram. Tags persist as a tags.txt run artifact.

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: wd14, joytag, florence2, joycaption.

input_image.description: The image to invert. Absolute mount path or artifact ref.

checkpoint.description: The WD14 weights name (auto-downloaded on first run).

exclude_tags.description: Comma-separated tags to prune from the output.

trailing_comma.description: Terminate the tag list with a comma (prompt-paste shape).

add_tag.description: JoyTag: tags force-prepended to the output (comma-separated). Ignored by WD14.

remove_tag.description: JoyTag: tags pruned from the output (comma-separated). Ignored by WD14.

caption_task.description: Florence-2: the vision task (live task vocabulary). Ignored by WD14/JoyTag.

caption_type.description: JoyCaption: the caption template (live vocabulary). Ignored by WD14/JoyTag/Florence-2.

caption_length.description: JoyCaption: target length (the node also takes word counts 20-260 — bare/API bodies only). Ignored by other families.

enum: Include information about whether there is a watermark or not.
Include information about whether there are JPEG artifacts or not.
Do NOT include anything sexual; keep it PG.
Do NOT mention the image's resolution.
You MUST include information about the subjective aesthetic quality of the image from low to very high.
Include information on the image's composition style, such as leading lines, rule of thirds, or symmetry.
Do NOT mention any text that is in the image.
Specify the depth of field and whether the background is in focus or blurred.
Do NOT use any ambiguous language.
ONLY describe the most important elements of the image.
Your response will be used by a text-to-image model, so avoid useless meta phrases.
extra_option.description: JoyCaption: one appended instruction (the full 28-option list rides bare/API bodies). Ignored by other families.

tools.name: tts_card
tools.description: Text-to-speech — Qwen3-TTS with CustomVoice personas and instruct-text emotion control

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: qwen3-tts, qwen3-tts-base.

voice.description: Preset speaker persona (CustomVoice) or .qvoice embedding path

style_instruction.description: Emotion and delivery control (e.g. 'speak with warm confidence')

qvoice.description: Pre-computed speaker embedding (.qvoice/.voice — the voice-lock card exports these). Present = synthesize with THIS voice instead of the preset one.

voice_pca_strengths.description: JSON knobs over the embedding's principal components, e.g. {"pca_pc1.dir": 0.5} — subtle voice direction without re-designing the persona.

tools.name: upscale_tools_card
tools.description: Diffusion upscale (SeedVR2-3B fp16) — the hidden tool card; also home of the consumed tool fragments (resize, pixel-upscale, rtx-vsr, concat, input)

input_image.description: The frame to restore. Absolute mount path.

resolution.description: 1080 = FHD rail. SeedVR2 redraws detail at this size.

max_resolution.description: The hard ceiling — inputs already past it pass through.

batch_size.description: Video frames ride batches; images are batch 1.

tools.name: video_gen_card
tools.description: Text/reference-to-video — the generate_video interface card boarding wan-vace and scail2-animate; one surface, one arm per family

model.description: The boarded family to run — the request's top-level `model`. Options: wan-vace, scail2-animate.

cfg.description: Lightning-distilled lanes run CFG 1 (guidance baked in).

sampler.description: Sampler — options resolve from the $samplers vocabulary at serve time

scheduler.description: Scheduler — options resolve from the $schedulers vocabulary at serve time

reference_image.description: The anchor frame — identity, subject, scene (wan-vace); the character to animate (scail2-animate).

pose_video.description: The motion source — SCAIL-2 drives the reference character with this video.

pose_strength.description: How tightly SCAIL-2 follows the driving motion.

tools.name: voice_lock_card
tools.description: Lock a voice persona — design, export, and reuse .qvoice embeddings for consistent character voices

voice_name.description: Name for the locked persona — becomes the .qvoice filename stem. Reused across every future TTS render.

style_instruction.description: The voice description — becomes the VoiceDesign prompt (e.g. 'A warm female voice with a British accent').
